comments.value: Oh I get this too! I have a color change wheel just like that gif, and a brightness slider that I have to be careful opening because my friends get flashbanged when I open it even if it's at zero.
It will do the same by opening the expression menu with a radial still open.
Many people use avatar scaling and this is the problem that makes them giant for a split second. It looks really bad
@{5f67899159b0841fe0d3891b|full_name}: Not an issue with GogoLoco since the value only update remotely after the radial is close.
@{5e44a1bd0c91c2477a8b8acb|full_name}: Ooh, this is the first useful usage of a opened/closed menu parameter I've heard of, lol
Still an issue three years later...
2025 and this issue still persists. "Tracked" since 2021 and never looked at again.. someone please..

If you select an item again when the parameter is 0.01 or higher in a RadialPuppet type item, it seems to be treated as 1.00 for about 0.5 seconds by everyone around you except yourself.

This does not occur when the parameter is 0, nor does the bug occur for myself.

The bug only occurs when the item is re-selected at 0.01 or above and to people around you other than yourself. We understand that you are busy, but please fix this.
Thank you!! Been waiting for this forever!
@{61734d8acc7413744089269c|full_name} I don't know why this bug took FOUR YEARS to fix, but hey, awesome that it's finally been dealt with! lmao

details:
When opening a radial menu, the animation visually play from 0 to 100 lightning fast, then settle at the value set prior the opening or not. Instead of being at the normalize value set locally.
Those issue only occur remotely. No difference when using a single state or a blend tree.
title: [BUG] Float on a radial open on wrong value remotely
